card.name: Comma after drug name in warnings
card.fires_on: The comma right after a drug name in an opening clause such as "Before prescribing X," or "Before initiating therapy with X,". Also "must" after "Anyone considering the use of X".

modes.label: Comma after drug in Before-clause
modes.description: A comma closing a "Before prescribing/initiating therapy with DRUG" clause, right before the main warning instruction.
modes.example: Before prescribing AZSTARYS<<,>> assess each patient’s risk for abuse,

modes.label: Verb after considering-use clause
modes.description: The word "must" after "Anyone considering the use of DRUG" in a boxed warning.
modes.example: Anyone considering the use of AUSTEDO XR or AUSTEDO<< must>> balance the risks of depression and suicid

card.writes: Little clear effect; it may favor a clause continuing with an instruction rather than an exclamation.
card.plain: It marks the point right after a drug name in a "before using this drug" warning, where the instruction begins.
